name: Notificity
description: Captures and categorizes incoming push notifications, with search by app or keyword. Built with Jetpack Compose, Room DB, and Material Design.

name: RainSurfer
description: Full-stack web app integrated with the Raindrop.io API for randomly discovering articles from saved collections. OAuth 2.0, article previews, mark-as-read flow.

name: Raindrop IO Remote MCP Server
description: An MCP server for accessing Raindrop.io bookmarks via HTTP/SSE transport. Deployed to Railway with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
